{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy guitars and melodic vocals fit my listening, but I would choose something heavier this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Death Magnetic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its aggressive riffs fit the heavier direction of my In Flames and Disturbed listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: X&Y; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its softer atmospheric rock does not match my current mood for heavier music.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Operation: Mindcrime II; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Progressive metal could suit my interest in Tool, but I am not ready to commit to this sequel album.
